## Description

Use bid/ask prices weighted by displayed queue size to estimate a microprice and short-term directional pressure.

## Where it may fit

Short horizon near the inside quote in liquid limit-order-book markets.

## Vehicles

Market-making and high-frequency equity/futures/crypto strategies.

## Required data

Best bid/ask prices and sizes, preferably depth and order updates, trades, timestamps and fees.

## Caveats

Useful horizons can be extremely short; backtests require realistic queue and fill simulation.
